demo_scope: 4:36 walkthrough: original 14 November core footage plus a 17 November Bitbucket, local file-transfer and availability update

capabilities.name: Source evidence → Jira → matching rescan
capabilities.summary: Twelve Solidity rules, source-bound reports and explicit Jira verification/completion. KAN-6 and a separate-site fixture completed the workflow.
capabilities.limit: Static findings and supplied evidence consistency do not certify safety or scanner execution.

capabilities.name: Bitbucket PR scans and Jira provenance
capabilities.summary: Automatic fixture Pipeline #1 passed; JSON/SARIF and full PR commits matched the Jira KAN-7 verification record.
capabilities.limit: Public isolated fixtures only. Import, verification and completion remain reviewer actions; no private/fork PR support or execution attestation.

capabilities.name: Team defence and reviewed owner contact
capabilities.summary: Entry-point ownership, explicit coverage gaps, attributed triage and retest completed KAN-8. A reviewed Jira owner mention retained its receipt.
capabilities.limit: Development 3.6.0 only; a self-mention is not an independent reviewer test, online presence or a read receipt.

capabilities.name: Encrypted conversation and file/folder handoff
capabilities.summary: Synthetic Alice/Bob verified exact devices, transferred a file and nested folder, then explicitly saved byte-identical copies. Names and paths travel inside the encrypted bundle.
capabilities.limit: Loopback lab only: 100 files / 10 MiB. No production identity, hosting, recovery, retention or physical mobile acceptance. Integrity is not malware scanning.

capabilities.name: Combined defence regression lab
capabilities.summary: One contract exercises 22 labelled properties: all 12 implemented detectors match in source/compiler modes; 24 paired behaviour/property tests passed.
capabilities.limit: Ten demonstrated properties remain undetected. The strict all-case gate fails as expected. Authored fixtures do not measure general accuracy.

next.name: Shared review queue
next.benefit: Bring owner, reviewer, deputy, evidence age, open gaps and the next handoff into one view.
next.acceptance: Two independent users review the same immutable evidence; changed or stale evidence invalidates approval.

next.name: Evidence-grounded Rovo teammate
next.benefit: Explain findings and draft triage from project-scoped evidence with visible agent attribution.
next.acceptance: Every claim links to evidence; cross-project reads fail and consequential actions require explicit review.

next.name: Contract and bytecode workbench
next.benefit: Share ABI, entry points, authority, storage, interactions and bytecode/source mappings.
next.acceptance: Every view binds to the artifact hash; unknown or inferred relationships remain labelled.

next.name: Deployment rehearsal and sign-off
next.benefit: Review local simulations, configuration changes and rollback plans before release.
next.acceptance: A reviewer can reproduce the plan and compare deployed-artifact identity; this does not authorize a live transaction.

next.name: Team outcome metrics
next.benefit: Track review age, stale evidence, time to verified remediation and incident handoff quality.
next.acceptance: Metrics show their source and time window, separate unknowns, and avoid scoring people or claiming protection from counts alone.
